gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro packs its words dense and lofty in the middle, with generous entrances into every letter's inner space. Mystery Quest's open-jawed curves make the sharper, more storybook half.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Noto Sans Nabataean reads crisp and modern, its lowercase nearly as high as the capitals. Mystery Quest brings the nostalgic, bookish flavor in big display moments, while the sans-serif text quietly carries the everyday reading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-nag-munda: Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads like a plain sans caught mid-unwrap, its c and s shapes opened wide and its lowercase rivaling the capitals. But shrink Mystery Quest too far and its bookish, open-jawed curves lose their storybook charm.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa has a clearly open mouth on its lowercase e, with lofty bowls and counters that feel modern and brisk. Mystery Quest does the nostalgic showpiece work; Newa does the steady reading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Solid and tidy, Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds the tails of its curves well back, so words form blocks rather than skylines. And Mystery Quest, with its open-jawed curves and bookish air, adds the nostalgic flourish above.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-old-hunga: Friendly and wide awake, Noto Sans Old Hungarian opens its a, e and s generously, so apertures stay open even at tiny sizes. And Mystery Quest keeps its bookish, nostalgic mood, leaving you free to shrink the body text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-old-north: Mystery Quest brings a bookish, nostalgic look, its curves open-jawed and its ascenders compact. Noto Sans Old North Arabian follows with a dense, lofty lowercase band and outward-pointing terminals, the sharpest difference between them.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-old-persi: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Old Persian lets its open counters breathe into the white space. Mystery Quest is best saved for big, short lines, where its bookish, nostalgic curves can show off their open jaws.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdi: Mystery Quest sets a bookish, nostalgic tone with open-jawed curves. Beneath it, Noto Sans Old Sogdian's x-height nearly reaches the capitals, and its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp even when shrunk.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-old-turki: Chunky and approachable, Noto Sans Old Turkic keeps its open-mouthed curves clear and its lowercase imposing. Mystery Quest sits above it, adding a nostalgic, bookish storybook flavor to the page.
